BREAKING | Spain / Europe
MADRID HOUSING DECREES FAIL; EARLY-ELECTION TALK RISES

Spain’s Congress rejected two government housing decrees Friday (about 178–172 and 184–166). Measures covered eviction protections, short-term-lease limits, and automatic rental renewals after protests sparked by an elderly woman’s eviction. Early-election talk rose; Sánchez opened a weekend reflection with no snap vote locked.

Sources: Al Jazeera https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/10/2/spains-parliament-rejects-govt-housing-decrees-amid-mass-protests · France 24 (AFP) https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20261002-spain-s-government-dealt-blow-as-lawmakers-reject-housing-bills · Euronews https://www.euronews.com/2026/10/02/spanish-congress-rejects-housing-laws-despite-sanchezs-warning-theyll-be-judged-sooner-tha

BREAKING | Germany / Europe
REFORM ROW RAISES FEARS FOR MERZ COALITION

Germany’s CDU is pressing SPD partners on pension and labor-market bills ahead of coalition talks next week. Reports say conservatives may withhold support for income-tax reform until those drafts move, feeding collapse speculation.

Sources: DW https://www.dw.com/en/germany-news-reform-row-raises-fears-for-merzs-coalition/live-79512757

BREAKING | Brazil / Americas
LULA vs FLÁVIO BOLSONARO — AMAZON POLICY ON THE BALLOT

Brazil votes Sunday in a presidential race where Amazon rules are a central stake. Axios: Lula vs Sen. Flávio Bolsonaro; deforestation fell sharply under Lula; outcome could reshape forest policy and U.S. ties.

Sources: Axios https://www.axios.com/2026/10/02/brazil-election-lula-flavio-bolsonaro-trump-amazon

BREAKING | G7 / Energy
G7 TO RELEASE UP TO 100M BARRELS OF DIESEL AND CRUDE

G7 leaders agreed to release up to 100 million barrels of diesel and crude from reserves over about four months, coordinated via the IEA, to steady fuel markets.

Sources: NBC News https://www.nbcnews.com/business/energy/g-7-diesel-crude-release-trump-macron-rcna601132 · BBC https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ck87zg8jnwngo

BREAKING | United States / Economy (Nationwide)
SEPTEMBER JOBS MISS — 29,000 ADDED; PRESSURE ON GOP

U.S. employers added about 29,000 jobs in September, below estimates, with unemployment near 4.2%. Soft hiring adds midterm pressure on Trump and Republicans.

Sources: Washington Post https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/2026/10/02/us-economy-added-29000-jobs-september-missing-estimates/

BREAKING | European Union / Migration
EU APPROVES MIGRANT “RETURN HUBS”; FIVE STATES PLAN THIRD-COUNTRY DEPORTATIONS

EU rules now allow return hubs in non-EU countries under human-rights safeguards. Greece, Germany, Austria, Denmark, and the Netherlands are pursuing a joint hub (Uganda/Rwanda often named); first facility eyed for 2027.

Sources: CBS News https://www.cbsnews.com/news/europe-eu-immigration-asylum-seeker-third-country-deportations/

EVERGREEN | South Pacific
WHALE SINKS YACHT; FOUR SAILORS RESCUED AFTER ~18 HOURS

Yacht *Tai Tam* struck a sperm whale ~250 nm north of Norfolk Island; crew abandoned to a life raft and were rescued by containership MV Sofrana Surville. All four survived.

Sources: CBS News https://www.cbsnews.com/news/whale-sinks-yacht-south-pacific-sailors-rescued-new-zealand/

EVERGREEN | Tech / STEM
APPLE TIGHTENS macOS FULL DISK ACCESS OVER AI-AGENT RISK

Apple will require more explicit user action before granting Full Disk Access, citing rising risk from autonomous AI agents that could reach files, mail, and messages.

Sources: TechCrunch https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/02/apple-says-its-tightening-macos-full-disk-access-controls-due-to-new-risks-from-ai-agents/

BREAKING | Israel–UAE / Travel
ARKIA FLIES FIRST DUBAI REPATRIATION AFTER EL AL CANCELS

After El Al rescue flights were canceled when landing permissions lapsed, Arkia operated the first approved repatriation flight from Dubai for Israelis stranded in the UAE.

Sources: Jerusalem Post https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-910399

EVERGREEN | Tech / STEM (Nationwide wire)
7-YEAR-OLD NVIDIA SHIELD TV JUMPS ~$100 ON AI SUPPLY PRESSURE

Ars Technica: older Nvidia Shield TV hardware is about $100 more expensive amid AI-related supply and pricing pressure.

Sources: Ars Technica https://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2026/10/the-7-year-old-nvidia-shield-tv-is-now-100-more-expensive-thanks-to-ai/

EDITOR’S BOX — Oct 2 International desk (G–PG)

Nepal Sep 15 pack retired. Adult/war draft withdrawn. Plate rated G–PG for under-13 standing (war/terror wires dropped). Watch: Spain election odds; Merz coalition; Brazil Amazon ballot; G7 fuel release; EU return hubs; Apple FDA controls. Print lock: curated from live wire ~3:30pm CT 2026-10-02. No RSS autopublish — raw /api/news has no age filters.
